text: Breizh Cola is brewed and owned by the Brasserie Lancelot (SIREN 950471177, SAS, La Mine d'Or, Val d'Oust; Simon Bruno Emmanuel Joly Président de SAS, Benjamin Dupuy Directeur Général), which commercialised the brand from 2002 through its then parent Phare Ouest; the Phare Ouest group, owner of Breizh Cola, was bought by the Normandy farmer cooperative Agrial (SIREN 428611719, nature juridique 6317), announced November 2020 with effect from January 2021. Agrial is owned by its farmer members ('A co-operative committed from farmer to consumer'), so the chain ends in private farmer ownership: no state or sovereign-fund stake exists.
short: Breizh Cola belongs to Brasserie Lancelot, inside the farmer-owned cooperative Agrial since 2021.
